## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 13, 2026 - Sep 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Arch Cee_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "Still 1 star. Given up hope on this app, its been years and you haven't fixed anything. Can't create meals, anything you add, just get returned to the logging. Changing the navigating menu every year when you've just gotten use to the old one, it benefits no one. Logs me out everytime I enter the app. I'm stopping my next subscription. Fix your damn app and stop charging overpriced subscriptions for an app you don't even fix. I don't care for your lame bot response, you're doing nothing."
            2. _Emma Smith_, Sep 17, 2026, 2/5: "After using this app for well over 10 years, I came back to it after a break, and you have to pay to do almost everything now which was always free, even to scan a barcode! Such a shame its turned into a money focused app... this uses to be the best app however, Im not sure it warrants the annual or monthly subscription - extremely disappointed."
            3. _John Rinehart_, Sep 15, 2026, 3/5: "great tool for tracking your daily habits and is fairly accurate considering these kinds of apps are notoriously unreliable I've used it to go into a calorie deficit for fat loss and recently changed goals to maintenance as I learn things about my own metabolism. the suggested macros and caloric intake has been pretty good. however there are some basic functions that are behind a paywall, a paywall that didn't exist 4 yrs ago. greed doesn't look good on anyone."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Sep 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Amanda Rose_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "the glitches on this app are unreal. The calories I enter will be correct, and the app will somehow calculate a completely different total number. My day will be 1400 calories, and it will show under total calories as 2200 or something silly. How do you mess up that bad when it's the entire point of your app?"
            2. _Jonathan_, Sep 14, 2026, 1/5: "I used it before and worked great but now I can't log my foods. when I try to add anything just freezes. I've uninstall and reinstall many times but everytime it freezes."
            3. _Thorsten Mootz_, Aug 30, 2026, 1/5: "New update is really bad and user unfriendly. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
<!--/ir-theme-->
